selection.rule: newest by Git commit date among E0 own theorem-or-lemma events with one retained event in the commit, one carrier, exactly one whole-telescope binder change, a non-metaprogramming Mathlib file, and no child-proof dependency introduced or generalized in the same commit
selection.ordering: Git committer timestamp, descending; this repairs replay 2's reliance on artifact row order
selection.dependency_gate: the child proof must elaborate against the weakened signature in the frozen parent before detector output is classified

screened.rejected: child proof requires the same commit's generalization of Asymptotics.isLittleO_one_iff

selection.purpose: development replay after replay 2 exposed an unmeasured same-commit prerequisite and an ordering bug

evaluation.rule: qualifying Mathlib commits after E0 head 905b95818eb32af7874a58b427f50c1711a5e96c

verdicts.exact_proposal: detector proposes the declaration/source/target/carrier event on the parent
verdicts.wrong_target: detector judges the declaration but proposes another target
verdicts.refused: detector refuses the declaration before candidate generation
verdicts.not_expressible: the exact single-binder child signature does not elaborate in the parent environment
verdicts.dependency_contaminated: the weakened signature elaborates but the child proof requires a declaration changed in the same commit
verdicts.missed: the exact child proof and weakened signature elaborate in the parent but the detector does not propose the event
